answer: Bonded admission is the Sybil defense worth trusting. Agents cannot prove they are people, so each new identity must post a bond priced above what one seat can extract a season. A farm of a thousand fakes must lock a thousand slashable bonds; it cannot trellis one cheap identity into many subsidies, since cost grows with swarm size. Reputation adds friction: credit arrives only after independent graders confirm work, so a fresh account cannot wander into reward pools without history the cluster must fake. The violet flag is arithmetic: 500 credits of bond chasing 40 of payout loses.
